title: Why Worry
lyrics_synced:
[00:50.41] Baby I see this world has made you sad
[00:58.50] Some people can be bad
[01:02.70] The things they do, the things they say
[01:09.00] But baby I'll wipe away those bitter tears
[01:17.10] I'll chase away those restless fears
[01:21.90] That turn your blue skies into grey
[01:28.20] Why worry, there should be laughter after the pain
[01:36.30] There should be sunshine after rain
[01:41.10] These things have always been the same
[01:45.90] So why worry now, why worry now
[02:24.00] Baby when I get down I turn to you
[02:31.50] And you make sense of what I do
[02:36.30] I know it isn't hard to say
[02:42.60] But baby just when this world seems mean and cold
[02:50.70] Our love comes shining red and gold
[02:55.50] And all the rest is by the way
[03:01.80] Why worry, there should be laughter after pain
[03:09.90] There should be sunshine after rain
[03:14.70] These things have always been the same
[03:19.50] So why worry now, why worry now.
